title.narrative: 4. Number of incidence of family violence against women (not in the responsibility of GIZ)

description.narrative: This specific indicator is of special importance to the EU and reflected in the indicative logframe matrix of the MinPAD RISE Programme. It will be monitored as well, even though it is not considered as being part of the Joint Action and will not be part of GIZs responsibility.The Philippine National Police (PNP) raises different statistics on genderbased violence based on different forms of crimes and differentiated by the perpetrator. The project will use the statistic of incidents filed under R.A. 9262, defining violence against women and children as physical, sexual, and mental but also economic abuse and violence perpetrated by an intimate partner (husband, exhusband, livein partner, boyfriend/girlfriend, fianc, who the woman had sexual/dating relationship). Crimes reported under R. A. 9262 do not include e. g. rape, concubinage, antisafe spaces or sexual harassment.As stated in the Gender Analysis prepared by the EU the official numbers on VAWC are most likely under reported due to gender stereotypes and cultural norms, as most reported perpetrators are members of the own household, e. g. husbands/partners, former husbands/partners and other relatives. During the COVID19 pandemic a significant drop in reported cases was reported, while it is to be assumed that during the lockdown the number of VAWC increased due to additional psychosocial stress. It is to be discussed, how to monitor the indicator keeing in mind the challenge of assessing the actual situation of women in Mindanao.
